articulos.titulo: Latest-model phone, sealed in its box
articulos.descripcion: Original. Sealed. My cousin who works at the port gave it to me. Pay up front and I ship it as soon as it arrives from abroad. No in-person pickups because I am shy.
articulos.respuesta: "Sure, buddy. To reserve it, send me your card number, the expiry date and the three little numbers on the back." Better not.

articulos.titulo: Gaming chair with only one armrest
articulos.descripcion: Reclines, spins and has lights. The other armrest left with my ex. She also took the beanbag.
articulos.respuesta: "Yes, still here. You can have it for 20 if you help me carry it down: fifth floor, no elevator."

articulos.descripcion: Three bedrooms, city view, hot water and wifi included. No viewings: the owner is traveling. The owner is always traveling. Deposit by bank transfer only.
articulos.respuesta: "Lots of people are interested. Transfer the deposit in the next ten minutes and it is yours. The owner will send you the keys when he gets back."

articulos.titulo: Microwave that works if you speak to it nicely
articulos.descripcion: It heats. Sometimes. You have to close the door gently and say "thank you". Not a joke. I am selling it because I bought one that does not need to be loved.
articulos.respuesta: "Yes, dear. But you come pick it up yourself and have a coffee, nobody visits me."

articulos.descripcion: Used twice in January. Since then it has been an excellent clothes rack. Comes with the clothes hanging on it, which I no longer know who they belong to.
articulos.respuesta: "Yes. Do you want it with or without the clothes? Same price either way."

articulos.titulo: Course: become a millionaire in 7 days
articulos.descripcion: I used to be like you: poor and without vision. Today I have a car I rented for the photo. Includes a PDF, a motivational audio and faith. The secret is selling this course.
articulos.respuesta: "Your first investment in yourself! Today's offer is $499. Tomorrow it is more expensive. Tomorrow is always more expensive."

articulos.titulo: Bundle of cables, no idea what they are for
articulos.descripcion: A whole box of cables. One of them will be good for something. None of them were good for me, but that is not the cables' fault.
articulos.respuesta: "Yes, still here. They are always still here. Cables never leave."

articulos.descripcion: The keys sound nice. It is missing the E, but you get used to it: I have been typing without it for three months and nobody noticed. Negotiable. Very negotiable.
articulos.respuesta: Nobody bought it. Not even at half price. The E left and took the customers with it.

articulos.descripcion: Works perfectly. The vertical green line comes free and never leaves. Ideal for someone who does not look at the right side of the screen.
articulos.respuesta: Someone offered $8 and a "blessings". Jair is seriously considering it.

articulos.descripcion: It is the spare one. The main one is not for sale: I have limits. Three speeds: low, medium and "the paper flies".
articulos.respuesta: You mark it as sold and regret it instantly. You list it again. It is the circle of life.

ayuda_payfoe: Each game's tokens buy items for that game's battles. They don't mix: every Jair is broke in his own way.
PayFoe collects what you transfer from your games and what you win in the Genesis Tournament. PayFoe buys the unlockables.
Tokens go from a game to PayFoe, never the other way around. Like a paycheck: it comes in, it leaves, it never comes back.
PayFoe charges no fees. It charges other things. They're in the terms and conditions, which nobody read.
Refunds? PayFoe doesn't know that word. It doesn't want to.
Customer support: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 9:01.
